actions.name: List available workflows
actions.description: Show the registered workflows without changing any files.

actions.name: Preview a workflow packet
actions.description: Preview the selected workflow JSON against a packet folder. This does not execute stations.

actions.name: Combine Markdown files
actions.description: Open the existing interactive Markdown combiner for a folder of notes.

actions.name: Vault split, number, and group tools
actions.description: Open the existing VaultTools menu. It asks before choosing an operation and path.

actions.name: Excel sheets to CSV
actions.description: Open the existing Excel-to-CSV PowerShell tool (desktop Excel is required).
